# Fixture Appeals Procedure

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Appeal deadline

An applicant whose residence permit application is refused may appeal within 21 days of the decision.

## 2 Appeal hearing

Appeals are heard by the Review Board. The applicant may bring one representative to the hearing.
